C1308.title: 96 Convicted in Changzhou Futures Pig-Butchering Scam
C1308.summary: The Changzhou Economic Development Zone Procuratorate in Jiangsu prosecuted 96 suspects for fraud in a pig-butchering scam disguised as futures trading. The case involved over 1,200 victims across 67 cities in 17 provinces, with total losses exceeding 13.32 million yuan. The defendants built emotional connections via social media to lure victims into investing on a fake futures platform.
